title: Understanding Regularization
text: As the regularization parameter \(\lambda\) approaches positive $$\infty$$, the model's complexity is heavily penalized. This means that the model will favor simpler solutions.

title: Effect of Regularization on Predictions
text: When \(\lambda\) is very large, the model tends to ignore the input features and focuses on minimizing the bias. What does this imply about the predictions?

title: Mean-Centered Data
text: Recall that \(\tilde{Y}\) is the mean-centered version of \(Y\). What is the mean of \(\tilde{Y}\)?

hintAnswer: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
title: Predictions with Large \(\lambda\)
text: Given that the mean of \(\tilde{Y}\) is $$0$$, what do the predictions of the model approach as \(\lambda\) becomes very large?
choices: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
